meditation.es:
En el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo.

Amén.

Dios todopoderoso y Padre, te damos gracias por haber bendecido a la Iglesia con el testimonio de San John Henry Newman, en quien resplandecen tu cuidado paternal, la verdad de Jesucristo y el Espíritu de conversión.

En él nos has dado un ejemplo de confianza en tu divina Providencia y en la intercesión de la Virgen María. En él has suscitado un santo ejemplo de fidelidad a las enseñanzas perennes de la Santa Madre Iglesia.

Con un amor especial por la educación católica y una oportuna advertencia contra los errores del relativismo, tu siervo John Henry Newman es un ejemplo luminoso para nuestro tiempo.

Concédenos, te suplicamos, por su intercesión y según tu santa voluntad, la renovación de una educación católica fiel y la fidelidad a la Iglesia una, santa, católica y apostólica, y la gracia especial que ahora te pido:

(menciona tu petición aquí…)

Por Cristo nuestro Señor. Amén.

Padre nuestro.

Dios te salve, María.

Gloria al Padre.

¡San John Henry Newman, ruega por nosotros!

En el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo.

Amén.
meditation.en:
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

Almighty God and Father, we give You thanks for blessing the Church with the witness of Saint John Henry Newman, through whom shines Your fatherly care, the truth of Jesus Christ, and the Spirit of conversion.

In him You have given us an example of trust in Your divine Providence and the intercession of the Virgin Mary. In him You have raised up a holy example of fidelity to the timeless teachings of Holy Mother Church.

With a special love for Catholic education, and due warning against the errors of relativism, Your servant John Henry Newman is a shining example for our times.

Grant us we beseech You, through his intercession, and according to Your holy will, the renewal of faithful Catholic education and fidelity to the one, holy, catholic and apostolic Church, and the special grace I now ask:

(mention request here…)

through Christ our Lord. Amen.

Our Father

Hail Mary

Glory Be

St John Henry Newman, pray for us!

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

Ave-Maria.

prayer.en:
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

Almighty God and Father, we give You thanks for blessing the Church with the witness of Saint John Henry Newman, through whom shines Your fatherly care, the truth of Jesus Christ, and the Spirit of conversion.

In him You have given us an example of trust in Your divine Providence and the intercession of the Virgin Mary. In him You have raised up a holy example of fidelity to the timeless teachings of Holy Mother Church.

With a special love for Catholic education, and due warning against the errors of relativism, Your servant John Henry Newman is a shining example for our times.

Grant us we beseech You, through his intercession, and according to Your holy will, the renewal of faithful Catholic education and fidelity to the one, holy, catholic and apostolic Church, and the special grace I now ask:

(mention request here…)

through Christ our Lord. Amen.

Our Father

Hail Mary

Glory Be

St John Henry Newman, pray for us!

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.
